examples.text: ko nu kho, bhante, vedayatī'ti? no kallo pañho'ti bhagavā avoca, vedayatī'ti ahaṃ na vadāmi.
kiñ'ca, bhikkhave, vedanaṃ vadetha? vedayatī'ti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā vedanā'ti vuccati. kiñ'ca vedayati? sukham'pi vedayati, dukkham'pi vedayati, adukkham'asukham'pi vedayati
añchāmi naṃ na muñcāmi, asmā sokapariddavā, ko me bandhaṃ muñcaṃ loke, sambodhiṃ vedayissati.
nanu me tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha idh'ekaccassa yaṃ evarūpaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti
sukhavedaniyaṃ, bhikkhu, phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhā vedanā. so sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sukhaṃ vā vedanaṃ vedayamāno sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti. dukkhaṃ vā vedanaṃ vedayamāno dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti.
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, ye kho keci atītam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayiṃsu, etāvaparamaṃ, na'y'ito bhiyyo.

70311.commentary: (NIDD1) yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhamman'ti. yo imaṃ dhammaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ jānāti so dhammaṃ vedi aññāsi apassi paṭivijjhī'ti, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ.

examples.text: pubbenivāsaṃ yo vedi, sagg'āpāyañ'ca passati, atho jātikkhayaṃ patto, abhiññā vosito muni.
sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhiparibbasānā, viggayha nānā kusalā vadanti, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ, idaṃ paṭikkosam'akevalī so.

examples.text: iminā kho etaṃ, āvuso, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ
so evam'assa veditabbo, āneñjasaṃyojanena hi kho visaṃyutto lok'āmis'ādhimutto purisapuggalo'ti.

70316.commentary: (DNa) paccattaṃ veditabbo'ti attanā'va veditabbo. (SNa) sabbehi ugghaṭitaññūādīhi viññūhi bhāvito me maggo, adhigataṃ phalaṃ, sacchikato nirodho'ti attani attani veditabbo'ti paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti.

examples.text: dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti

70317.meaning1: this should be known; this should be understood

examples.text: puṭṭho kho pana pañh'ābhinīto ahāpetvā alambitvā paripūraṃ vitthārena parassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti. veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ayaṃ bhavan'ti.

sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno asubhasaññāparicitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato methunadhammasamāpattiyā cittaṃ anusandahati appaṭikulyatā saṇṭhāti, veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā, abhāvitā me asubhasaññā
veditvā so sucaritassa phalaṃ, uṇhīsasīsattam'idh'ajjhagamā, byākaṃsu byañjananimittadharā, pubbaṅ'gamo bahujanaṃ hessati.

70320.commentary: (DNa) vediyake pabbate'ti so kira pabbato pabbatapāde jātena maṇivedikāsadisena nīlavanasaṇḍena samantā parikkhitto, tasmā vediyakapabbato' tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gato. (DNt) vedi eva vediko, vediko eva vediyo ka-kārassa ya-kāraṃ katvā, tasmiṃ vediyake. ten'āha maṇivedikā-sadisenā'ti-ādi, indanīl'ādi-maṇimaya-vedikāsadisenā'ti attho.

examples.text: addasā kho sakko devānam'indo bhagavantaṃ magadhesu viharantaṃ pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇagāmo, tass'uttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṃ.
passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati
pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
katamo ca, bhikkhave, vedanānaṃ vipāko? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, vediyamāno tajjaṃ tajjaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinibbatteti puññabhāgiyaṃ vā apuññabhāgiyaṃ vā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, vedanānaṃ vipāko.
so kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmī'ti pajānāti, jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmī'ti pajānāti
so'haṃ sallassa'pi vedhanahetu dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃ.
sīladassanasampannaṃ, dhammaṭṭhaṃ saccavedinaṃ, attano kamma kubbānaṃ, taṃ jano kurute piyaṃ.
pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti, na ca tāva kālaṅ'karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.

puccheyyāma mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ kañci'd'eva desaṃ, sace āyasmā channo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyā'ti. pucch'āvuso sāriputta, sutvā vedissāmā'ti.

examples.text: atha vā pan'assa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti, yo me ayaṃ attā vado vedeyyo tatra tatra kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti so kho pana me ayaṃ attā nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassatī'ti

70334.meaning1: belonging to the Videha country; Videhan
70334.commentary: (SNa) vedehamunino'ti paṇḍitamunino. paṇḍito hi ñāṇasaṅkhātena vedena īhati sabbakiccāni karoti, tasmā vedeho'ti vuccati. vedeho ca so muni cā'ti, vedehamuni. (JAa) vedehan'ti videharaṭṭhasāmikaṃ. (JAa) vedehassā'ti tava videharājassa.

examples.text: atha kho thullatissā bhikkhunī anattamanā anattamanavācaṃ nicchāresi, kiṃ pana ayyo mahākassapo, ayyassa ānandassa vedehamunino sammukhā dhammaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ maññati?
sukh'āvaho dukkhanudo, vedehassa yasassino, matiṃ te paṭihaññāmi, usuṃ palasatena vā.

70335.meaning1: epithet of Ānanda; Videhan sage; (comm) wise sage
70335.commentary: (SNa) vedehamunino'ti paṇḍitamunino. paṇḍito hi ñāṇasaṅkhātena vedena īhati sabbakiccāni karoti, tasmā vedeho'ti vuccati. vedeho ca so muni cā'ti, vedehamuni. (APAa) vedehamunī'ti vedeharaṭṭhe jātā vedehī, vedehiyā putto vedehiputto. monaṃ vuccati ñāṇaṃ, tena ito gato pavatto'ti muni. vedehiputto ca so muni ce'ti vedehiputtamunī'ti vattabbe vaṇṇ'āgamo'ti-ādinā niruttinayena i-kārassa attaṃ putta-saddassa ca lopaṃ katvā vedehamunī'ti vuttaṃ.
70335.notes: Note the contradiction between the commentaries.

examples.text: atha kho thullatissā bhikkhunī anattamanā anattamanavācaṃ nicchāresi, kiṃ pana ayyo mahākassapo, ayyassa ānandassa vedehamunino sammukhā dhammaṃ bhāsitabbaṃ maññati?
tathāgataṃ jetavane vasantaṃ, apucchi vedehamunī nat'aṅgo, sabbaññubuddhā kira nāma honti, bhavanti te hetubhi kehi vīra.

70336.meaning1: name of a laywoman in Sāvatthī

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, imissā'y'eva sāvatthiyā vedehikā nāma gahapatānī ahosi. vedehikāya, bhikkhave, gahapatāniyā evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato, soratā vedehikā gahapatānī, nivātā vedehikā gahapatānī, upasantā vedehikā gahapatānī'ti.

tesaṃ rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto na labhati otāraṃ na labhati ārammaṇaṃ.

70342.commentary: (ANa) na vedhatī'ti na kampati n'ānusocati. examples.text: yato ca kho paṇḍito āpadāsu, na vedhatī atthavinicchayaññū, paccatthikāssa dukhitā bhavanti, disvā mukhaṃ avikāraṃ purāṇaṃ.

kassa brāhmaṇa tvaṃ bhīto, sadā udakam'otari, vedhamānehi gattehi, sītaṃ vedayase bhusaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, issāso vā issās'antevāsī vā tiṇapurisarūpake vā mattikāpuñje vā yoggaṃ karitvā, so aparena samayena dūrepātī ca hoti akkhaṇavedhī ca mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.

70355.commentary: (ANa) puna brāhmaṇo tadeva abhivādan'ādikammaṃ bhagavati apassanto, ayaṃ idaṃ lokajeṭṭhakakammaṃ vineti vināseti… maññamāno bhagavantaṃ venayiko'ti āha. tatr'āyaṃ pad'attho vinayatī'ti vinayo, vināsetī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: venayiko bhavaṃ gotamo'ti

70356.meaning2: who has to be led away, got rid of
70356.commentary: (ANa) atha vā yasmā etaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ na karoti, tasmā ayaṃ vinetabbo niggaṇhitabbo'ti maññamāno bhagavantaṃ venayiko'ti āha… vinayo eva venayiko. vinayaṃ vā arahatī'ti venayiko, niggahaṃ arahatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: venayiko bhavaṃ gotamo'ti

70357.commentary: (ANa) bhagavā pana yasmā rāg'ādīnaṃ vinayāya vūpasamāya dhammaṃ deseti, tasmā venayiko hoti. ayam'eva c'ettha pad'attho, vinayāya dhammaṃ desetī'ti venayiko.

examples.text: ahañ'hi, brāhmaṇa, vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi rāgassa dosassa mohassa, anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi. ayaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya, venayiko samaṇo gotamo'ti, no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesī'ti.

70373.commentary: (SNa) evaṃ sukhumaṃ kho, bhikkhave, vepacittibandhanan'ti taṃ kira padumanāḷasuttaṃ viya makkaṭajālasuttaṃ viya ca sukhumaṃ hoti, chettuṃ pana n'eva vāsiyā na pharasunā sakkā. yasmā pana citten'eva bajjhati, cittena muccati, tasmā vepacittibandhanan'ti vuttaṃ.

70377.commentary: (ITIa) vepullo'ti rājagahaṃ parivāretvā ṭhitesu pañcasu pabbatesu vipulabhāvato vepullo'ti laddhanāmo.

examples.text: passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, etaṃ vepullaṃ pabbatan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

ekapuggalassa, bhikkhave, kappaṃ sandhāvato saṃsarato siyā evaṃ mahā aṭṭhikaṅkalo aṭṭhipuñjo aṭṭhirāsi yath'āyaṃ vepullo pabbato, sace saṃhārako assa, sambhatañ'ca na vinasseyyā'ti. etam'atthaṃ bhagavā avoca.

examples.text: oḷārikassa'pi kho ahaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, attapaṭilābhassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desemi… paññāpāripūriṃ vepullattañ'ca diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā'ti.
yathāpaṭipannānaṃ vo saṃkilesikā dhammā pahīyissanti, vodānīyā dhammā abhivaḍḍhissanti, paññāpāripūriṃ vepullattañ'ca diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā'ti.

tesaṃ sutvā dhammikañ'hi kho rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahi, no ca kho adhanānaṃ dhanam'anuppadāsi. adhanānaṃ dhane ananuppadiyamāne dāliddiyaṃ vepullam'agamāsi. dāliddiye vepullaṃ gate aññataro puriso paresaṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyi.

70382.commentary: (VINa) vepullamahattan'ti vipulabhāvena mahattaṃ. saṅgho hi yāva na theranavamajjhimānaṃ vasena vepullamahattaṃ patto hoti, tāva sen'āsanāni pahonti. sāsane ekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā na uppajjanti. vepullamahattaṃ pana patte te uppajjanti.

70391.commentary: (DNa) na ca vebhūtiyan'ti bhassasamācāre ṭhito'pi bhedakaravācaṃ na bhāsati. (SNPa) vibhūtī'ti vināso, vibhūtiṃ kāsati karoti vā'ti vibhūtikaṃ, vibhūtikam'eva vebhūtikaṃ, vebhūtiyan'ti'pi vuccati, pesuññass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tañ'hi sattānaṃ aññam'aññato bhedanena vināsaṃ karoti. sesaṃ uttānattham'eva. (DNt) vibhūti vuccati visuṃbhāvo, tattha niyuttan'ti vebhūtikaṃ, tadeva vebhūtiyaṃ, pesuññaṃ. ten'āha bhedakaravācan'ti.

examples.text: idha, bhante, ekacco na c'eva musāvād'upasañhitaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati na ca vebhūtiyaṃ na ca pesuṇiyaṃ na ca sārambhajaṃ jay'āpekkho, mantā mantā ca vācaṃ bhāsati nidhānavatiṃ kālena.
musā ca so na bhaṇati, atho na khīṇabyappatho, atho vebhūtiyaṃ n'āha, mantā atthaṃ ca bhāsati.
